review: Entire actual stuffed pita? Branded wrapper, paper, dish and fingers must be absent. Correct meat/vegetable variant and true 1:1 sharpness; no clipped bread, no dangling isolated food. Reject if poor.
rejection_reasons: The food is hanging out of the pita with no visible bottom bread; the entire serving is not preserved.
Logo-paper/packaging remains at the top and behind the pita after masking.
A straight, unnatural lower crop removes necessary food/bread support; the result is not a natural isolated whole kebab.
